invariants.rationale: No code path in the method uses all three flips as true simultaneously for a unique branch; checks for an edge case.
Every control path is defined by at least one of these combinations due to the nested if logic.
If 'flipDiagonally' is not set, then both horizontal and vertical flips can be arbitrary, but if set, the code avoids redundancy.
Reflects role of flipHorizontally in affecting cell state across control paths.
